procedural_matters: The hearing was conducted by a panel under N1.4(b).
Damir Nakrast (coach) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: GRE 217949 sailed race 3 without the mast retention line tied.
GRE 217949 tied the mast retention line before the finish
The Technical Committee noticed GRE 217949 tie her mast retention line immediately before the finish.
Photo and video taken at the finish line by the Media team confirms GRE 217949 tying her mast retention line before the finish.
The Technical Committee applied a standard penalty of 30% in accordance with SI 17.10.
conclusions: GRE 217949’s score was made significantly worse of her own fault. Therefore, the requirements of RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
